calibration_note: Maps the model output to the share of past cases that reached target 1 before the stop (walk-forward predictions, Jan 2023 - Sep 2025, isotonic fit on equal-count bins).
policy_note: A coin gets a signal when its score is in the model's top 3% ('strong'). If no coin has had a signal for 24 hours, the best free coin gets one if its score is at least the model's median ('standard'). At most 5 new signals per 4-hour candle (the highest scores), one trade at a time per coin.

test.note: 53 coins with full history (21 trained + 32 never used in training). The 9 newest coins in the list (HYPE, XMR, GRAM, HBAR, CRO, TAO, ONDO, OKB, ASTER) had no test data here; the site's own backtest covers them.
